head: Spotify AI DJ: new voices and a setting for less talking
dek: Spotify's AI DJ now lets Premium users pick from new voices with their own personalities, and switch off most of the talking between songs.
details: There are seven English voices with British, American, Irish, Australian and Indian accents, and two new Spanish voices, Nico and Fabi, which replace Livi. The original voice, X, stays. With less commentary on, the DJ only speaks briefly when you start and stop it. It's rolling out from 10 November to Premium users in the more than 95 markets where DJ is available. Spotify says over 94 million Premium listeners use DJ.
means: If you liked the DJ's picks but not the chatter, you can now keep the music and drop most of the talk.
todo: Search "DJ" in Spotify, tap the three-dot menu and choose a voice and your commentary setting.
